verdict.rationale: PlanetScale documents an official hosted MCP server that gives agents access to database information and tools. It also offers `pscale sql` for non-interactive agent SQL and service-token authentication for headless agents, so agents can do database work. However, nothing in the evidence shows the tools are scoped to separate read-only from destructive operations, which is the core of the safe-delegation story. Missing for 10: documented read-only vs. destructive tool separation, permission scoping of MCP/service-token tools for SQL and schema changes, and independent hands-on corroboration.
